subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Habari RECIPIENT_NAME,
Hii ni barua yangu ya mwisho kuhusu mpango wa ubadilishaji wa walipaji kwa {Brand}, kufuatia ujumbe wangu wa awali na ule wa benchmark za CPI. Ikiwa ubora wa mlipaji na nyongeza vipo kwenye ramani yako ya robo ijayo, naweza kukutumia mtazamo wa makundi kwa aina ya mchezo na usomaji mfupi wa kundi la kudhibiti wiki hii. Kama muda haukufai sasa, nitaachia hapa na kurudi nyuma. Vyovyote vile, una muktadha utakaohitajika utakapokuwa muhimu.
angle: direct close with easy out (release if timing wrong)
register_notes: Stage 3 sw Kenya gaming midcore/hardcore: references original email and earlier stages (the CPI benchmark note) in first sentence; direct close with genuine easy out (releases prospect if timing is wrong); offers holdout read and per-genre cohort view; no MobUpps figure; zero question marks; kundi la kudhibiti = holdout kept in Swahili; CPI kept Latin; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'.
